is a small grassy island in the middle of the ocean. The terrain of this island is mountainous, though there are flat grassy plains on the island. Various rocks and trees can be found on the island. A bridge crosses over a water source.

The brown path begins and ends at two caves at both ends of the island. The path crosses a wooden bridge across the water.

was a large island in the middle of the ocean. Despite this, a river flows through the middle of the island, with the source being an artificial pipeline at the top of a waterfall. When the river reached the sea, it was split in two by a small grass island. The terrain of the island was mountainous, though there were flat grassy plains on the island. Various rocks and trees could be found on the island. Some sand could also be seen and a smaller rock island could be seen in the middle of the ocean.

The brown stone path began and ended at two caves at both ends of the island. The path crossed a cobblestone bridge over the river.
is identical to the current version, except terrain water surrounded the map, instead of baseplate water.

took place on a low lying grassy island in the middle of the ocean. There were few objects of note. There were three smaller chunks of rocks lower than the main terrain. Four trees and a grass mound could be seen. Some broken bits of rock by the caves could also be seen.

The black slate path began and ended at two caves. The path cutback on itself many times as well as taking some long straights.
